claims.claim: The fixture matches the requested dimensions, part name, and place target.
claims.evidence: request.md requires a 0.16 x 0.16 x 0.01 m fixture with one box and place target named top. asset/asset.json declares kind fixture. readings.json size_cm is [16,16,1], collision_boxes contains only top on base, and place_targets contains only top. asset/model.urdf confirms these dimensions and names.

claims.claim: Collision geometry matches the visual mat and leaves its upper face accessible.
claims.evidence: All four renders (front.png, side.png, top.png, iso.png) show a flat square slab with no rim or cavities. asset/model.urdf has identical visual and collision boxes: size [0.16,0.16,0.01], origin [0,0,0.005], zero rotation. readings.json has no collision meshes. probes/01_place.out confirms top bounds [-0.08,-0.08,0] to [0.08,0.08,0.01].

claims.claim: Joint travel, moving-part attachment, and interpenetration checks pass as inapplicable.
claims.evidence: request.md specifies no joints; readings.json joints is empty. asset/model.urdf contains only link base and no joints. probes/01_place.out reports joints {} and overlaps [].

claims.claim: Handle grasp and pull checks pass as inapplicable.
claims.evidence: request.md specifies no handles and readings.json handles is empty.

claims.claim: A 5 cm, 0.1 kg cube settles on place target top.
claims.evidence: probes/01_place.py drops a 0.05 m cube (0.1 kg per Probe) from [0,0,0.15] onto the fixed mat. probes/01_place.out reports the same center [0,0,0.03495] at cumulative frames 30, 90, and 150 (1, 3, and 5 seconds). The cube bottom is z=0.00995, within 0.00005 m of the top surface at z=0.01, with its footprint inside the mat bounds. Four base-to-cube contacts each carry 0.245 N, totaling 0.98 N. No rim is present or required.

claims.claim: Free rigid-object upright settling passes as inapplicable to a fixed fixture.
claims.evidence: request.md specifies a fixture loaded fixed, flat side up; asset/asset.json kind is fixture. The fixed=True test in probes/01_place.py leaves base at [0,0,0] with identity rotation after 150 frames, as recorded in probes/01_place.out.
